aboutPreview.title: WINZ Logistics — Belgium-Based EU Customs Clearance Broker
aboutPreview.description1: Based in Zele, WINZ Logistics supports importers, exporters, and freight forwarders with EU customs clearance backed by over 14 years of experience. We handle customs formalities for shipments arriving by sea, air, and road — including through Antwerp, Rotterdam, and Brussels Airport.
aboutPreview.description2: Our team manages HS code classification, declaration filing, and duty and VAT calculations, coordinating the clearance process through to cargo release. We help businesses prepare accurate documentation and meet compliance requirements to reduce avoidable delays.

expertise.desc: Managing customs clearance and cross-border compliance across all 27 EU member states for over 14 years.

services.title: EU Customs Clearance Services
services.description: WINZ manages the full customs compliance chain for cargo entering and leaving Belgium — from pre-lodgement declaration through duty payment, cargo release, and inland delivery.

import.title: Import Clearance
import.desc: We handle all import customs formalities on your behalf — declaration filing, HS code classification, duty and VAT calculation, and cargo release. Every shipment is processed accurately and on time, with a dedicated specialist managing your account throughout.

export.title: Export Clearance
export.desc: We manage the full export declaration process, including AES filing, EUR.1 preferential origin certificates, dual-use goods controls, and VAT proof-of-exit compliance. Your cargo leaves Belgium with complete, accurate documentation every time.

transit.title: Transit Clearance
transit.desc: T1 and T2 transit declarations, NCTS digital filing, and guarantee facility coverage for cross-border movements across EU member states — all handled under one service agreement. Your cargo moves without delays at any border crossing.

transport.title: Container Haulage
transport.desc: Post-clearance inland transport for 20ft, 40ft, and High Cube containers from port terminal to final delivery address. Haulage is arranged directly alongside the clearance process — refrigerated and dry van options both available.

warehouse.title: Bonded Warehousing
warehouse.desc: Import duty and VAT deferral through our bonded warehouse in Belgium, with storage, pick-and-pack, palletising, re-labelling, and container unloading all handled in a fully compliant customs environment.

air_freight.title: Air Freight Clearance
air_freight.desc: Customs clearance for air cargo at Brussels Airport Zaventem and Amsterdam Schiphol — covering ICS2 pre-lodgement, declaration filing, and duty payment. Same-day release available for shipments with complete documentation submitted before arrival.

road_freight.title: Road Freight Clearance
road_freight.desc: CMR documentation, border crossing procedures, and compliance management for trucks and refrigerated vehicles entering Belgium from Turkey, Eastern Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa. Standard and temperature-controlled road cargo both covered.

hs_code.title: HS Code Classification
hs_code.desc: Correct HS code classification against the EU Combined Nomenclature and TARIC database before any declaration is filed. The applied code determines duty rate, VAT treatment, and trade restrictions — misclassification leads to penalties and cargo holds.

fast_track.title: Fast Track Clearance
fast_track.desc: Declarations pre-lodged before cargo arrival, cutting port dwell time and preventing storage charges on delayed consignments. Same-day release available at Port of Antwerp and Brussels Airport for time-sensitive shipments.

fcl.title: FCL Customs Clearance
fcl.desc: Full container load clearance for 20ft and 40ft containers at Port of Antwerp and Rotterdam — bill of lading release, declaration filing, duty payment, and terminal release handled without requiring the importer to coordinate with multiple parties.

lcl.title: LCL Customs Clearance
lcl.desc: Consolidated cargo arriving through Belgian and Dutch ports cleared individually — each consignee's goods separated at the deconsolidation warehouse, declared under the correct HS code, and released with full duty documentation.

consulting.title: Customs Consulting
consulting.desc: Guidance on EU import and export regulations, Incoterms 2020 selection, duty optimisation, AEO applications, and CBAM/MACF compliance. Businesses entering the EU market for the first time receive a full customs compliance review before their first shipment moves.
